caption: The video showcases a showroom-style suspended ceiling of metal grid and square panels, densely populated by several operating ceiling fans. The most prominent fixture sits at center-top, its four curved amber blades spinning continuously into motion-blurred arcs around a bright white frosted light dome. This rotation is already underway and continues throughout, with no start or stop visible. Surrounding fans likewise keep turning: a red-bladed fan with a white dome below center, a white-bladed fan and a dark wooden-bladed fan with a warm amber light on the right, and a brown-bladed fan at the top-right edge all reposition their blurred blades as the video progresses. A chrome-bodied fan with transparent blades on the left shows only faint, barely perceptible movement. The glowing fixtures, the grid seams, and a row of lit bulbs along the bottom-left remain fixed in the same positions, holding the viewpoint steady. Only the blades' rotational orientation changes; the fans and ceiling structure keep their places.
relations: Rotating amber blades around fixed white dome produce continuous motion-blurred arcs.
Surrounding fans with red, white, and wooden blades maintain rotational motion without shifting position.
Stationary metal grid and light fixtures persist while fan blades spin continuously.
Left chrome fan exhibits minimal movement relative to faster-spinning surrounding fans.
